findings.summary: crates/server/src/sources.rs:52: no test checks the repo names added to the 'no repo's PRs could be read (...)' error in 120fddb. With them removed, a_failed_part_keeps_its_earlier_value_and_marks_the_source still passes, because it only checks starts_with("no repo's PRs could be read"). End to end the names were present: '(bbooth/booking, bbooth/sdlc-board)'.

crates/server/src/github.rs:124-127: after a failed list read, an empty Vec is stored as the repo's 'last' PRs. The retry then says 'kept its PRs from an earlier read', although none were ever read. Observed on a fresh server with both lists failing: the first attempt's error said 'no earlier PRs', and the retry a millisecond later said '(kept its PRs from an earlier read)'.

crates/server/src/main.rs:17: no test covers treating an empty GITHUB_TOKEN as unset. End to end it works: with GITHUB_TOKEN='', the warning was logged and every request reached the proxy with no Authorization header.

Verification environment: the egress proxy authenticates api.github.com reads (curl with no token: X-RateLimit-Limit 15000), so GitHub's real 60-an-hour anonymous limit was not observed. The server sent no token. The merge item used real booking PR #53 served as open, because no sdlc-board PR exists for TRU-10. Stage labels were overridden through the Linear proxy.
